NoticeDocument.title: NoticeDocument
NoticeDocument.description: Represents an extracted and evidence-validated campus notice with bilingual English and Hindi checklists, gap detection warnings, and grounded Q&A history.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this notice.

title.description: Title or heading of the campus notice.

rawNoticeText.description: Raw OCR or pasted source text of the notice.

purposeEn.description: Plain-language summary of the notice purpose in English.

purposeHi.description: Plain-language summary of the notice purpose in Hindi.

purposeQuote.description: Exact verbatim quote from rawNoticeText grounding the purpose.

deadline.description: Extracted deadline date/time or explicit not-specified label.

deadlineQuote.description: Exact verbatim quote from rawNoticeText grounding the deadline.

eligibilityQuote.description: Exact verbatim quote from rawNoticeText grounding eligibility.

documentsRequired.description: Required documents extracted from the notice.

contactDetails.description: Issuing office or contact person details.

contactQuote.description: Exact verbatim quote from rawNoticeText grounding contact details.

checklistEn.description: Sequential action checklist items in English.

checklistHi.description: Sequential action checklist items in Hindi.

checklistQuotes.description: Verbatim source quotes corresponding to each checklist item.

completedIndices.description: Zero-based indices of completed checklist items.

flaggedMissingEn.description: Missing or ambiguous details flagged by gap detection in English.

flaggedMissingHi.description: Missing or ambiguous details flagged by gap detection in Hindi.

followUpQuestionsEn.description: Recommended follow-up verification questions in English.

followUpQuestionsHi.description: Recommended follow-up verification questions in Hindi.

qaEntries.description: Grounded Q&A exchanges recorded for this notice.

groundingScore.description: Percentage (0-100) of claims verified against verbatim source quotes.

modelUsed.description: Identifier of the Gemma 4 model and validation pipeline used.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notice was saved (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the notice was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/notices/{noticeId}.description: Stores per-user analyzed notices, bilingual checklists, evidence quotes, gap alerts, and Q&A history.
